body: Implemented HQ-SPEC-PRIME-101's pkg/norn kernel library in a new top-level repo NORN/ (added to go.work). Five interfaces (Artifact, Proposer, Oracle, Gate, Registry) per spec section 3. NDJSONRegistry: append-only NDJSON file + in-memory index, mutex-guarded Record (same bug class as this session's IDUNA syncAppleToGit race — guarded here from the start). CheckLineage: mechanical Lobian hazard check per section 2 (no artifact may be graded by an oracle whose lineage includes that artifact's proposer). DefaultGate: reference implementation enforcing oracle-version comparability refusal (section 5) and monotone promotion (sections 2/4). 10 tests covering all four section-8.1 properties (monotone promotion, replay determinism, lineage-violation rejection, oracle-version comparability refusal) plus a concurrent-Record regression test, all green under go test -race. Storage-shape open question (section 10) decided: flat NDJSON, no dedicated store. While this was in progress HQ-SPEC-PRIME-097 (Fixed Points) landed in the repo for the first time (EMILY/HQ-SPEC-PRIME-097-fixed-points.md, GitHub web upload) - this was a known blocking gap noted in BACKLOG.md SECTION 141 (PRIME-101 cites 097 as its mathematical foundation but 097 didn't exist anywhere in the repo when S141-01 was built). Read 097 in full and checked it point-by-point against what was already built: monotone promotion, frozen-metric/oracle-version comparability, and the Lobian hazard check all matched 097's Kleene/Tarski-Knaster/Banach/reflective-hazard framing exactly as implemented, with zero interface or property-test changes required. Metrics-layer concerns 097 introduces (k contraction constant, period-2 oscillation detection, spec-drift gap, scope lattice projection) are historical computations over Registry.History(), which NDJSONRegistry already supports in full - those belong to the not-yet-built nornd daemon (S141-04), not the kernel library. Also registered PRIME-097 in EMILY/context/golden-docs-index.md as HQ-PRIME-097 (tier 1) and resolved the SECTION 141 blocking note + HUMAN UNBLOCK QUEUE row in BACKLOG.md. Separately, two TYLER HQ-SPEC docs (LORE-104 Queen Sally Doctrine, CANON-TYLER-105 Epoch Extinction) that landed via GitHub web upload earlier in this session were also golden-indexed and changelogged. Full reconciliation writeup: NORN/CLAUDE.md and BACKLOG.md SECTION 141.
title: S141-01: pkg/norn kernel library (+ PRIME-097 reconciliation)
